[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Palmer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its early [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. He worked as an [[Imperial Port Master]] and was in charge of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byrsym]].

==Personality and traits==
Palmer viewed anyone who was not a part of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] as a threat, but was particularly biased against non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Due to the fact that Humans constituted only a small part of Byrsym's population, Palmer believed that the planet could explode into chaos at any moment, so he was prepared to maintain order on the world at any cost.
